note: P4367 (Pro 30:12) — there are those clean in their own eyes but not washed of their filth.

dims.v: self-righteous self-deception — thinking oneself pure while unwashed of filth
the being 'clean in one's own eyes' while unwashed of one's filth — the self-righteous self-deception that congratulates itself on a purity it does not have, blind to its own defilement
(the unwashed filth it will not see)
the self-flattering blindness that mistakes its own filth for cleanness

tahor (clean/pure), self-assessed — 'there are those who are CLEAN in their own eyes but are not washed of their filth' (30:12); the second mark of a corrupt generation is self-righteous self-deception — a purity claimed, not real. The heart most defiled may be surest of its own cleanness (cf 16:2; 20:9; Luke 18:11).
